angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 911,367 km at 112.18 pc = 0.11 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 8.9141 +/- 0.0142 mas (same row, RUWE 1.10): 112.18 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.31 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Mireles et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-201 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026SciA...12f2618M/abstract): 911,367 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.32 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Mireles et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-201 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026SciA...12f2618M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6423 +/- 86 K from Mireles et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-201 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026SciA...12f2618M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Mireles et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-201 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026SciA...12f2618M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-201.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.324, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-201 (pscomppars): spectral type F, from Mireles et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026SciA...12f2618M/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-201 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.24 dex, from Maciejewski & Łoboda 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJ...988L..63M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-201 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.41664, from Mireles et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026SciA...12f2618M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-201 (pscomppars): age 0.666 Gyr, from Mireles et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026SciA...12f2618M/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-201 (pscomppars): rotation period 53 d, from Mireles et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026SciA...12f2618M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-201 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 9.52 km/s, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
